availability_legend.available: Source is populated in the current inspected callsite.
availability_legend.partial: Only a partial representation is populated.
availability_legend.not_produced: Field exists in a DTO but current callsite leaves default or does not construct it.
availability_legend.not_available: Current value is explicitly forced/defaulted and is not evidence.
availability_legend.available_but_not_projected: Source exists but is not included in the PPO observation/critic payload.
availability_legend.not_correlated: Payloads exist but lack a shared decision identity/hash.
availability_legend.available_shadow_only: Diagnostic recommendation exists but is not an observed fact or PPO target.

excluded_legacy_projections.reason: The first element is an order-dependent alias, not an independently evidenced focus signal. The canonical schema keeps the full completed_traits set and does not encode its first item as a priority/focus.

The current builder aliases completed traits into core traits without proving semantic equivalence. The canonical schema represents completed_traits once; core_traits is excluded until an independent authoritative definition exists.
